review.boundary_review: The strip at x≈0–335 is the facing fol. 267b (fragments 'natha …', 'hati', '…es beginning …2', 'Śaradarasarpe,', '…khaṇḍe putra)'). These are not transcribed as target records. Gutter arrows on the target page are linked to facing-page notes only as possible attachments. These arrow positions are consistent with the overview of fol. 267b: c. 186 (1), d. 38 (1-2), d. 37, d. 44 (1), d. 39, d. 41, d. 42, d. 43 (1) and d. 43 (2). Two further facing notes have no visible arrows and remain unresolved. Fol. 268b does not continue this page.

region_review.top: The page number 268 is at the top right. The first row (c. 186 (1)) carries an interlinear 'Dhana', a caret insertion and '13/16' above the numerals. Nothing else is above it.
region_review.middle: Dense rows run from d. 437 (3) to d. 43 (3). The heading shares its line with d. 38 (1-2), and the cancelled d. 125/128 row carries a cross-reference. Many overwritten numerals have corrections above them.
region_review.bottom: The cancelled e./c. 9 row is overwritten by the 'see Bṛhadāraṇyaka Up.' note. It is followed by e. 25 (3), d. 568 (1) and the continuation line '2. Ānanda Tīrtha'. The space below is ruled and blank.
region_review.left_margin: There are ticks and arrows beside the shelfmarks, and dots level with c. 157 (3). Binding stitch holes are at the gutter near y≈2640 and y≈3430. Facing-page fragments lie beyond the gutter.
region_review.right_margin: No marginal text appears beyond the numeral and script column.
region_review.interlinear: Interlinear writing comprises: 'Words only', 'Dhana', '13/16', the ff. line under d. 38 (1-2), '2' and '10/12' (d. 37), '2' over 1 (d. 38 (3)), '11/12', the corrections on d. 40, '16?7(?)' and '5/7', '11' and '6/7'. All are represented.
